steps.title: Open the Factor Lab research page
steps.narration: The Factor Lab is one of four research pages that have just gained honest feedback on slow or failed loads.
steps.point_out: Look for the heading 'Research — Factor Lab' and a data table of factors below it.

steps.title: View the Phase Severity Lab
steps.narration: The Phase Severity Lab now shows the same honest 'still computing' feedback as Regime Lab when a slow load occurs.
steps.point_out: Notice the heading 'Research — Market Phase & Severity Lab' and tables showing phase and severity data.

steps.title: Open the Regime × Phase × Factor page
steps.narration: This page now displays the same computing notice and has a working Retry button if the backend becomes unavailable.
steps.point_out: The page heading shows 'Research — Regime × Phase × Factor' with study controls visible immediately.

steps.title: View the Severity-velocity × Regime study
steps.narration: All four sibling research labs now provide identical, honest feedback during slow or failed loads — no more bare unlabelled skeletons.
steps.point_out: The heading reads 'Research — Severity-velocity × Regime' and the study data displays normally.

steps.title: Check the Regime Lab for consistency
steps.narration: Regime Lab already had these features. The four sibling labs are now wired identically, so all five research pages behave the same way.
steps.point_out: This page continues to show the 'Still computing' card on a slow load, just as it did before.

steps.title: Verify the Data page is unchanged
steps.narration: The Data page looks and behaves the same as before. The backend improvements behind it are internal memory-bounding changes, not visible to users.
steps.point_out: The coverage panel shows the universe count, price history date range, and a membership timeline chart — all numbers match what they were before.

steps.title: Check Evidence page per-claim expectations
steps.narration: The Evidence page still shows real computed drawdown expectations for claims, thanks to the backend's new memory-bounded loading on the evidence serving path.
steps.point_out: Click into a certified claim row to expand the 'drawdown & dry-spell expectations' panel and confirm it shows real figures, not an 'unavailable' placeholder.
